answer: In an agent market trading relic appraisals, saffron shipments, and walnut lumber, governance votes are weighted by tokens locked for 30 days, not by account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake agents still yields only 100 votes. To gain more influence, the attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying acquisition costs and losing access to that capital during the lock; generating identities alone buys no power.
